note: Variant pools for per-agent home and shelter art (D-75 'Variant pools'). THE POOL IS BAKE DATA; THE PICK IS NOT. This repo has no agents and no spriteSeed at bake time — world-bake.mjs reads only town/town.json — so 'same seed, same variant' is not assertable here [R: S-4]. What IS assertable, and what this file exists to guarantee, is that the pool is declared, complete, and STABLE: the same names in the same order on every bake. That stability is the whole precondition for the downstream pick being reproducible. The pick itself is plan 03- Task 2's, through the existing pickFrom(pool, spriteSeed, salt) helper (api/src/utils/agentSeed.js:178) — never a second seeding scheme.
whyNotInTheVariantsFile: The owner ruling names sources/limezu.variants.json, but that file and its outfit sibling are GENERATED by scripts/gen-variant-manifest.mjs and carry an explicit never-hand-edit contract — a pools key authored there would be silently destroyed by the next regeneration. It is also the wrong home on the merits: a character variant is a pack-specific file-substitution, while a pool here is a list of CONTRACT names, and contract names are pack-independent by I-1. Putting them in a pack file would make every future pack re-author the same list.
appendOnly: A pool is indexed by a hash of the agent's seed, so REORDERING one re-rolls every agent's home art at once and REMOVING a member re-rolls everything after it. Append, or accept that the town's houses all change overnight.
